research.title: Image Preprocessing for Object Recognition Under Blur
bullets: Implemented assigned image preprocessing routines for a blur robustness study, following provided specifications for resizing, normalization, and dataset partitioning.
Checked transformed images for labeling consistency and assembled evaluation summaries comparing supplied classifier predictions across clean and blurred inputs.

work.title: Inventory and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming deliveries against packing lists, recorded stock discrepancies, and routed damaged or missing items for follow-up.
Prepared order paperwork, maintained organized inventory records, and coordinated routine pickup arrangements with customers and dispatch staff.

projects.title: Handcrafted Feature Baseline for Scene Classification
bullets: Implemented a scene classification baseline using spatial color histograms and a linear support vector machine with standardized input features.
Evaluated predictions on a held-out image split, inspected confusion patterns, and compared histogram representations with raw pixel features.
